svg.text: Option A.2: Mobile Signer in Accounts, Passport for the rest
Accounts shows the QR code and one Continue with Passport button. Passport stays as today.
Already have a pubky? Import it
3 signed parent grant, encrypted for Accounts
6 redirect back with a child grant
+ Mobile Signer users never leave Accounts.
+ Passport needs no QR code and no change.
+ The click can open Passport in a pop-up instead, so the Accounts tab stays.
− SSO and import users click once more before Passport opens.
− Accounts has its own sign-in page, so sign-in options appear on two sites.
